I have resolved the issue where sliced querysets passed to [`Prefetch`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2142) were not disallowed early and resulted in errors upon queryset evaluation.

### Root Cause
[`Prefetch`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2142) validated `RawQuerySet` and querysets using `values()` or `values_list()` during initialization, but did not check if the provided `queryset` had been sliced (`query.is_sliced`). Since prefetching filters related objects across parent instances using `queryset.filter(...)`, passing a sliced queryset caused an error when filtering later during evaluation.

### Solution
Added a validation check in [`Prefetch.__init__`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2143-L2165) to raise `ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")` when `queryset` is sliced.
